name: Idempotency
definition: calling multiple times = same result as once

name: Modus Ponens
definition: if P→Q and P, then Q

name: Short
definition: Circuit Evaluation — stop when result known

name: Halting Problem
definition: cannot predict if arbitrary program stops

name: Depth
definition: First Search (DFS) — go deep before wide

name: Breadth
definition: First Search (BFS) — go wide before deep

name: Event Sourcing
definition: store all state changes as events

name: Critical Section
definition: only one thread at a time

name: Pure Function
definition: same input → same output, no side effects

name: Snapshot
definition: save state at point in time

name: Trunk
definition: Based Development — main only, short branches
